identification: 7-piece mixed hi-fi: (1) Marantz champagne integrated amplifier with slider tone/balance controls and push-button source selectors, (2) matching Marantz champagne slim tuner (linear dial), (3) matching Marantz champagne "METAL" cassette deck. Units 1-3 are a matched Marantz budget rack set of c.1983-86 (PM-2xx/3xx, ST-3xx, SD-2xx/3xx family; exact model numbers unreadable). (4) separate silver-faced analogue tuner with large dial and centre tuning knob, older (late 1970s) and probably a different brand. (5) Marantz semi-automatic belt-drive turntable (TT-1xx type) with dust cover, cartridge fitted. (6-7) pair of slim floorstanding speakers, full-height grey grilles, orange/cherry timber plinths with a small square badge and outrigger feet, likely 1990s-2000s, brand unread.

viewing_check: Read model plates on amp, tuner, cassette (rear) and turntable; read the speaker badge and rear label (brand/model/impedance); identify the silver tuner; power each unit on; check turntable belt, platter spin, arm lift and stylus; check speaker surrounds.
